info.title: Storage Server
info.description:
File storage service for the Media Generation API.

## Authentication

All endpoints require authentication via X-API-Key header or api_key query parameter.
Use the same API key as the main Media Generation API.

## Usage

Upload files to get file references that can be used in the Media Generation API:

```bash
# Upload a file
curl -X POST "https://storage.fast-gen.ai/v1/upload" \
  -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -F "file=@image.png"

# Response
{
  "success": true,
  "file_hash": "file:a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4",
  "filename": "image.png",
  "file_size": 12345,
  "mime_type": "image/png"
}
```

Use V1 endpoints for `file:`-prefixed hashes. Use V2 endpoints for raw storage ids.
Generated media downloads are served by bucket `download_url` values returned from the media API, not by storage-server proxy routes.

## Storage Limits

- **Max file size**: 50 MB per file
- **Storage quota**: 250 MB per API key for user uploads
- **File TTL**: 3600 seconds since last use for user uploads
- **Generated result TTL**: 1800 seconds from upload; generated results do not count toward user quota

## Supported File Types

**Images**: .bmp, .gif, .jpeg, .jpg, .png, .webp

**Videos**: .avi, .mov, .mp4, .webm

**Audio**: .m4a, .mp3, .ogg, .wav

**Documents**: .pdf

post.description:
Upload a file and get back its hash.

- Validates file size
- Validates file extension and MIME type
- Calculates MD5 hash
- Deduplicates if same file already exists
- Auto-deletes old files if storage limit exceeded

post.description:
Upload generated media and get back its hash.

Generated media bypasses the user-upload per-file size limit and user
storage quota. It uses a shorter generated-result TTL.

get.description:
Get file as data URI by hash.

- Validates ownership
- Updates last_used_at timestamp
- Returns file as data URI

delete.description:
Delete a file by hash (owner only).

Returns 404 if file not found or not owned by user.

head.description:
Check if file exists (returns 200 if exists, 404 if not).

Does not return file data or update last_used_at.

get.description: Get current storage usage for authenticated user.
